data_as_of: Futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, WTI, gold, BTC: Yahoo Finance v7 quotes ~7:38 a.m. CT (futures delayed ~10 min). Pre-market prices/volumes: StockAnalysis.com quotes and pre-market lists ~7:47–7:50 a.m. CT. Cash closes are Friday Nov 6.
headline: Futures rise about 0.8–1.4% after last week's AI selloff, but Nvidia falls about 5% pre-market as its board investigates reports about CEO Jensen Huang; October CPI is due Tuesday.
drivers: Stock futures are higher after last week's AI-led rout and Friday's mixed close: Dow and Russell 2000 futures lead (+1.2% and +1.4%), with S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.8%. Nvidia (~7% of the S&P 500) is down about 5% pre-market after its board opened an investigation into reports about CEO Jensen Huang, including a memo to staff and reported links to a suspected Chinese intelligence figure; reports say Trump backed Huang staying on, and several details remain unverified. Other chipmakers are higher (AMD +3.9% on an Oppenheimer upgrade to Outperform, AVGO +3.1%, ASML +4.3%), and Alphabet is up about 2.4% after unveiling two new TPU chips. In Asia, the Nikkei and Kospi rose more than 1%. WTI fell about 4% to near $87 after Trump said renewed strikes on Iran were unlikely while talks continue, which lifted airlines (DAL, UAL, AAL +4%). Gold is up 1.5%, and Bitcoin is down about 1.6% near $74.6K on regulation worries and a reported Binance breach. VIX is down to about 23. Friday's strong jobs data keeps December rate-hike talk alive ahead of Tuesday's October CPI. Berkshire's Q3 operating earnings fell 5.8% and cash hit a record $377.4B; BRK.B is flat.
